# Carcavelos Forecast – Friday 19 June 2026

**Small but clean—get out early before the wind picks up.**

**Morning (03:00–11:00):** Expect 0.8m waves with consistent 0.7m swell at 6.7s from WNW. Light northerly winds keep conditions tidy, especially between 06:00–07:00 when the breeze drops to just 4km/h. This is your golden window—glassy and manageable. Water sits around 17°C early, warming to 22°C by late morning.

**Through the day:** Swell gradually fades as the morning progresses; waves drop to 0.76m by 10:00. Afternoon brings a wind swing to NNW with gusts building to 18km/h by 18:00, creating chop. Wave heights tick up slightly (0.86m) due to wind energy, not swell.

**Tips:** Ride a shortboard or fun board—this isn't a power day. Dawn patrol beats crowds and guarantees the cleanest water. Skip the afternoon unless you enjoy windswell texture.
